pathSubtitle: Practice the language of job interviews — from first impressions to tough questions and salary negotiation.

lessons.title: First Impressions
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed First Impressions successfully

questions.prompt: Why is Sam at the office?
options: For a job interview at ten
questions.feedback: Correct! Sam is at the office for a job interview at ten.

questions.prompt: What does the HR assistant offer Sam?
questions.feedback: Correct! The HR assistant offers Sam water.

lessons.title: Tell Me About Yourself
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed Tell Me About Yourself successfully

questions.feedback: Correct! The candidate studied Business Management.

questions.prompt: Why does the candidate's manager give them urgent tasks?
options: They are reliable and finish on time
They have nothing else to do
questions.feedback: Correct! The manager gives them urgent tasks because they are reliable and finish on time.

lessons.title: Handling Tough Questions
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed Handling Tough Questions successfully

questions.prompt: What mistake did the candidate make?
options: Sent an email to a wrong address
Sent a report to the wrong client
questions.feedback: Correct! The candidate sent a report to the wrong client.
Correct! The candidate's weakness is difficulty delegating tasks.

lessons.title: Salary Negotiation
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed Salary Negotiation successfully

questions.prompt: What salary range does the candidate request?
What does the candidate ask about when the salary is low?
questions.feedback: Correct! The candidate asks about the full package and benefits.

lessons.title: Senior-Level Strategic Interview
lessons.completionSummary: You have completed Senior-Level Strategic Interview successfully

questions.prompt: What did the candidate do first to tackle the customer service problem?
questions.feedback: Correct! The candidate first conducted a root-cause analysis.

questions.prompt: How did customer satisfaction scores change?
questions.feedback: Correct! Customer satisfaction scores rose from 58% to 81%.
